name: University of Auckland
summary: A city campus in Auckland, six faculties from Arts and Education to Engineering and Medicine; your IB total is your rank score for each degree.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with 24+ points, English A (SL or HL) or English B HL 5, and any maths. Your IB total is your rank score: 26 for Arts and most Science, 27 Commerce, 32 Engineering.

dates.label: Semester One 2027 (February start): most degrees close
International applications close for a Semester Two 2027 (July start)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year, 480-point honours degree. You study a broad engineering base in Part I, then specialise in one of ten fields, from civil, mechanical and software to biomedical and mechatronics engineering.

needs.note: SL Maths AA may be accepted by grade; SL Maths AI is not
SL Physics may be accepted by grade

programmes.selectionNote: Guaranteed entry at a rank score of 32 (your IB total) with HL Maths and Physics; if you are slightly below, you are considered while places remain.

flagshipSource.title: University of Auckland news: Civil and Structural Engineering in the QS global top 50

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science, Psychology major
programmes.about: A 360-point Bachelor of Science with a Psychology major: quantitative and qualitative approaches with laboratory or field work, and a capstone course communicating psychology through grant proposals, podcasts and print.
programmes.selectionNote: Your IB total is your rank score; 26 guarantees entry to most BSc majors. A separate four-year Bachelor of Psychology starts in 2027.

flagshipSource.title: University of Auckland news: Psychology up 23 places to 28th in the QS subject rankings

programmes.name: Bachelor of Education (Teaching)
programmes.ib: IB 26 plus IELTS Academic 6.0 with no band below 6.0; an interview, police and safety checks and referees' reports.
programmes.about: A full-time, 360-point degree to become a certificated teacher in New Zealand, specialising in early childhood, primary or Maori-medium teaching, with 80 days of teaching experience in year three.
programmes.selectionNote: Rank score 26 (your IB total) for entry, then admission is subject to a satisfactory interview, police and safety checks and referee reports.

flagshipSource.title: University of Auckland news: Education back in the QS global top 30, in the top 50 for 14 years

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Education
faculties.line: Rank score 26 for Arts, Fine Arts, Music, Dance and Education (Teaching); Music, Dance and Education add an audition or interview.

faculties.name: Business School
faculties.line: Rank score 27 for Commerce and Property; conjoint degrees need 28.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Design
faculties.line: Engineering (Honours) 32 with HL Maths and Physics; Architectural Studies 31; Design and Urban Planning 27.

faculties.name: Faculty of Law
faculties.line: Law Part I needs an offer in another bachelor's degree; Part II places are limited and ranked on Part I grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Health Sciences and Biomedical Science 28, Nursing 31; Medicine, Pharmacy and Optometry follow a first year elsewhere.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Rank score 26 for most Science majors and Psychology; 28 for Cell and Molecular Bioscience, Exercise Science and similar.

notes: EU citizens pay the international fee: for 2027 the university estimates NZ$42,236 for a Bachelor of Arts, NZ$51,020 for Commerce and NZ$60,910 for Engineering (Honours), plus a student services fee.
Your IB total is used as the rank score (a 27 gives 27 out of 45); 24 points with the full Diploma meets the University Entrance standard, but each degree needs its own higher rank score.
Medicine, Pharmacy, Optometry and Medical Imaging are entered after a first year in another degree, with their own earlier closing dates.
